T0648.title: Transfer Code
T0648.definition: A transfer code is an electronic credential used to transfer, verify, or redeem ticketed or reserved entitlements.
T0648.description:
Transfer codes appear in electronic tickets, appointment slots, membership benefits, attraction entry, event registration, and platform benefit gifting. In legitimate workflows, they move a ticket or slot from the original holder to a transferee and prove entitlement during redemption or entry.

In black-market scenarios, scalpers may use transfer codes as deliverables and resell them through screenshots, links, SMS messages, in-account gifts, or secondary-platform transactions. Without real-name binding, transfer-count limits, validity controls, and abnormal-transfer monitoring, transfer codes can amplify ticket scalping, platform-fraud risk, and entry-verification disputes.
T0648.usageExample: The platform found one seller repeatedly listing transfer codes for multiple events, while transferee phone numbers were strongly associated with the buyer accounts' device fingerprints.
